forms from schools, keyed and analysed at ministry headquarters; last census before the project was 2017

systems.system: Primary leaving examination results (National Examination Board)
systems.tiers: imported into DHIS2-DEMIS for district analysis

note: No fact: DHIS2-DEMIS is stated to collect school-level indicators each term on a paper tool keyed at the district, not a record per learner, so it is classed census although termly; the EMIS it describes is the annual school census, keyed at headquarters. The article does not itself state that schools keep learner records on paper; it says districts relied on Excel sheets and paper after the 2017 census.
